# help showrcopy
showrcopy - Show details of the Remote Copy configuration

SYNTAX
    showrcopy [options <arg>] [links]
    showrcopy [options <arg>] [hosts [<group_name_or_pattern> ...]]
    showrcopy [options <arg>] [groups [<name_or_pattern> ...]]
    showrcopy [options <arg>] [targets [<name_or_pattern> ...]]

DESCRIPTION
    The showrcopy command displays details of the Remote Copy configuration.

AUTHORITY
    Any role in the system

OPTIONS
    -d
        Displays more detailed configuration information.

    -qw
        Display additional target specific Peer Persistence
        related configuration where applicable.

    -domain <domainname_or_pattern>[,<domainname_or_pattern>...]
        Shows only Remote Copy groups whose virtual volumes are in domains with
        names matching one or more of the specified domain name or pattern. This
        option does not allow listing objects within a domain of which the user
        is not a member.

SPECIFIERS
    links
        Specifies all Remote Copy links.

    hosts [<group_name_or_pattern>]
        Specifies either all host definitions of specific group(s) by name or
        glob-style patterns of Active Peer Persistence groups.

    groups [<name_or_pattern>]
        Specifies either all Remote Copy volume groups or specific Remote Copy
	volume group(s) by name or glob-style patterns.

    targets [<name_or_pattern>]
        Specifies either all target definitions or specific target(s) definition
	by name or glob-style patterns.

NOTES
    If the showrcopy command is used with no specifiers, all configuration
    information is displayed.

    If showrcopy links|groups|targets|hosts is used without specifying a name,
    information for all links, groups, or targets is displayed.

    See help on sub,globpat for information on glob-style patterns.

    To limit the performance impact of remote copy on the rest of the system,
    the number of volumes that are concurrently synchronizing is limited. This
    limit is not user-configurable and applies to the initial synchronization
    as well as subsequent resynchronizations for synchronous as well as
    asynchronous periodic groups.

    A Domain column may be included by using the setclienv command to
    set listdom to 1.  The listdom option is also set to 1 if the CLI was
    started with the -listdom option, or if the CLI was started with the
    TPDLISTDOM environment variable set. Please run "cli -h"  and
    "setclienv -h" for details of the environment variables.

    Long names can cause the display to be very wide. Use -shortnames
    to display shortened 31 character names for objects. Use the setclienv
    command to set shortnames to 1. The -shortnames option is also set to 1
    if the CLI was started with the -shortnames option, or if the CLI was
    started with the TPDSHORTNAMES environment variable set. Run "cli -h"
    and "setclienv -h" for details of the environment variables.

EXAMPLES
    The following example displays output from the showrcopy command:

        cli% showrcopy

    The following example displays output from the showrcopy groups <pat>
    command, where <pat> is specified as b* and 1*:

        cli% showrcopy groups b* l*

    Use the following to get a description of each column in the above examples:
        clihelp -col showrcopy
